name: Chemical & Process
description: Bulk chemical storage and handling, reactor systems, heat transfer equipment, distillation, and process safety monitoring.

sub_industries.name: Chemical Storage & Handling
sub_industries.description: Bulk storage tanks and transfer systems for hazardous and non-hazardous chemical feedstocks and products.

device_types.name: Chemical Storage Tank
device_types.description: Fixed-roof or floating-roof tank storing liquid chemical feedstocks or products. Process safety monitoring is critical due to hazardous material risk.

tags.name: Level
tags.description: Liquid level measured from tank bottom.

tags.name: Temperature
tags.description: Liquid temperature. Critical for products with narrow safe operating temperature ranges.

tags.name: Vapor Pressure
tags.description: Tank vapor space pressure. High pressure on atmospheric tanks indicates vent blockage or exothermic reaction.

tags.name: Leak Detector
tags.description: Secondary containment leak sensor. True indicates liquid detected in berm.

sub_industries.name: Reactors & Pressure Vessels
sub_industries.description: Pressure vessels, reactors, and process columns operating above atmospheric pressure.

device_types.name: Pressure Vessel
device_types.description: ASME-rated pressure vessel used in chemical processing. Process safety monitoring centers on pressure and temperature relative to design limits.

tags.name: Operating Pressure
tags.description: Vessel operating pressure. Must remain below MAWP.

tags.name: Operating Temperature
tags.description: Vessel operating temperature. Affects material yield strength and design pressure.

tags.name: Fill Level
tags.description: Vessel fill level as a percentage of total volume.

tags.name: Relief Valve Status
tags.description: Pressure relief valve open status. Activation indicates overpressure event.

sub_industries.name: Heat Transfer
sub_industries.description: Industrial heat exchangers, condensers, and reboilers used in chemical and refining processes.

device_types.name: Shell & Tube Heat Exchanger
device_types.description: Shell-and-tube heat exchanger transferring heat between two process streams. Fouling monitoring via differential pressure and temperature approach.

tags.name: Shell Side Inlet Temp
tags.description: Shell side fluid temperature at inlet.

tags.name: Shell Side Outlet Temp
tags.description: Shell side fluid temperature at outlet.

tags.name: Tube Side Inlet Temp
tags.description: Tube side fluid temperature at inlet.

tags.name: Tube Side Outlet Temp
tags.description: Tube side fluid temperature at outlet.

tags.name: Differential Pressure
tags.description: Shell side pressure drop. Increasing DP indicates fouling buildup.
